lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-intensity circular pixel clusters arranged in semi-regular vertical alignments posterior to the gills and across the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersecting with white blobs to form a distinctive grid-like pattern across the primary field of view.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent longitudinal ridge running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with highlights on the upper edge and shadowing below.

other_distinctive_markers: Dense, high-contrast spotting pattern visible on the dorsal surface and leading edge of the right pectoral fin.
